subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw accept this optional sourceActor attribution contract as plugin SDK and memory supplement surface before the broader durable provenance model lands?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but the permanent public contract for sender attribution across plugins, memory recall, and prompt context is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Approve stack and land in order
options.body: Accept the optional sourceActor contract and merge #96738, #96862, #96863, then this PR so the channel, SDK, and memory surfaces stay aligned.

options.title: Defer to durable provenance
options.body: Pause this PR and let #42647 define the durable source/provenance model before adding plugin-facing attribution fields.

options.title: Narrow the API surface
options.body: Ask the author to remove or reduce the public SDK/memory supplement additions and keep only non-contract prompt guidance for now.

recommendation.title: Approve stack and land in order
recommendation.body: Accept the optional sourceActor contract and merge #96738, #96862, #96863, then this PR so the channel, SDK, and memory surfaces stay aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on plugin-facing memory-state and channel-context contracts where recent history points to this handle.
